templates.title: snsdl
templates.description: Self-hosted web UI for yt-dlp: paste a link, pick a quality, download on your LAN. Also audio, playlists, subscriptions, live streams and photo posts.
templates.note: Set DATA_PATH to an absolute folder on this host and PUID/PGID to the owner of that folder (id -u, id -g over SSH). The container fixes the folder's ownership on start. Intended for a trusted LAN only.

env.name: DATA_PATH
env.label: Data folder on the host
env.description: Absolute path; downloads, settings and cookies live here

env.name: PUID
env.label: PUID
env.description: User id the app runs as (owner of the data folder)

env.name: PGID
env.label: PGID
env.description: Group id the app runs as

env.name: PORT
env.label: Port
env.description: Host port for the web UI

env.name: TZ
env.label: Timezone
env.description: For the nightly cleanup, e.g. Europe/London
